title: Moses foretold the same
source_text: VI. Similia quoque praedixerat Moses, Deut. 30. Circumcidet, inquit, Dominus Deus tuus cor tuum, & cor seminis tui, ut diligas Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, & in tota anima tua, ut possis vivere. Et paulo post, Tu autem reverteris, & audies vocem Domini Dei tui, faciesque universa mandata quae ego praecipio tibi hodie. Et abundare te faciet Dominus Deus tuus in cunctis operibus manuum tuarum.
pass_a_gloss: VI. Moses also had foretold similar things, Deut. 30. The Lord your God, he says, will circumcise your heart, & the heart of your seed, that you may love the Lord your God with all your heart, & with all your soul, that you may live. And a little after, But you shall return, & hear the voice of the Lord your God, and do all the commandments which I command you today. And the Lord your God will make you abound in all the works of your hands.
pass_b_english: Thesis VI. Moses too had foretold something similar. In Deuteronomy 30 the promise runs: the Lord your God will circumcise your heart and your offspring's heart, so that you love him with all your heart and all your soul, so that you may live.

Shortly afterwards come the words: 'Then you will return, hearing the Lord your God's voice and carrying out every commandment I command you today; and the Lord your God will make you abound in all the works of your hands.'

choices.why: The prophetic promise of the covenant of grace under which the law is written on the heart.
